title: Built heritage decision support
summary: Research documents exploring sensor- and AI-informed decision support for heritage conservation in Johor Bahru.

title: IoT for heritage environments
summary: A research framework for environmental sensing, visitor impact and predictive conservation, including proposed integration with historical climate data.

title: FC Abstract Review Assistant
summary: A bilingual abstract-review application with rule-based checks, reviewer overrides and printable reports. It assists human review; it does not approve abstracts automatically.

title: Thesis-to-Book Transformation Engine
summary: A Malay-language scholarly writing manual with eighteen phases, quality gates, search and reading progress. It guides transformation of a thesis into a book.

title: AI tools for postgraduate research
summary: A collection of research-tool resources covering literature discovery, visualisation, citation management and systematic reviews.

title: AI untuk Warga KRT
summary: Mobile-first Malay-language activities and practical AI prompts developed for the KRT Meranti community workshop.
